regime: Forced selling in metals, with silver and miners hit hardest
takeaway: Gold fell about 3.3% to a 14-month low near $3,723 and silver about 5% after the Fed minutes showed almost all officials expect more rate hikes, with the dollar near a 19-month high; this matches the site's forced-selling-in-metals, silver-under-stress and gold-downtrend checks. Gold miners fell about 6%, more than gold itself, and the leveraged miner and silver funds fell far more. Tech held up better, with the Nasdaq up 0.4% while the S&P 500 slipped for a fifth day and the VIX eased to about 24.6.
